candidate.blueprint_locator: Physiological Integrity — Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies: evaluate medication orders, prepare/administer medications safely, and provide medication education.
candidate.blueprint_topic: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies — fosfomycin administration teaching
candidate.educational_objective: Teach correct administration of oral fosfomycin tromethamine for acute uncomplicated cystitis: one prescribed sachet is dissolved in water and taken as a single oral dose rather than repeated daily or swallowed dry.

options.A: Dissolve the contents of one prescribed sachet in water and take it as a single oral dose.
options.B: Take one sachet every day until urinary symptoms completely resolve.
options.C: Swallow the dry granules directly because mixing with water reduces absorption.
options.D: Expect the medication to be administered only by intravenous infusion for uncomplicated cystitis.

candidate.rationale: A is correct. Current DailyMed labeling states that for women 18 years of age and older with uncomplicated urinary tract infection (acute cystitis), the recommended dose is one sachet of fosfomycin tromethamine granules for oral solution. The contents must be dissolved in water and taken orally. The label also warns not to use repeated daily doses for a single episode because repeated dosing did not improve clinical or microbiologic success and increased adverse events. B therefore gives an unsupported multidose regimen. C contradicts the preparation instructions. D is incorrect because this labeled product is an oral granule formulation.
candidate.source_claim_supported: For labeled treatment of acute uncomplicated cystitis in adult women, fosfomycin tromethamine granules are administered as one oral sachet dissolved in water; repeated daily dosing for the same episode is not recommended.
candidate.source_document_title: Fosfomycin Tromethamine Granules for Oral Solution Prescribing Information
candidate.source_locator: Dosage and Administration: recommended dosage for women 18 years and older with uncomplicated UTI (acute cystitis) is one sachet; Preparation: dissolve the entire contents of the single-dose sachet in water and take orally; General precaution: do not use more than one single dose for one episode because repeated daily doses did not improve outcomes and increased adverse events.
candidate.source_organization: U.S. Food and Drug Administration labeling via DailyMed
